device.description: 12-bit 500 kSPS SAR ADC with internal 2.5 V reference and synchronous serial interface
device.note: ads7834.pdf (SBAS098A) p.2 pin configuration and assignments, p.3 specifications (VCC 4.75-5.25 V, VIH, straight binary), p.8 Figure 2 and Table I timing, digital interface, p.9 Figure 3 basic conversion timing, p.10 Figure 4 power-down timing, Figure 5 LSB-first timing, p.11 short-cycle and data format

pages: p.2 (pins), p.3 (specs), p.8 (Table I timing), p.9 (Figure 3), p.10 (Figures 4-5), p.11 (short-cycle, data format)
notModeled: analog input and internal reference (VREF is the reference output, overdrivable by an external reference)

CONV is a convert-start input, not a chip select: the model treats it as an active-low frame (the 'SPI interfacing' use of Figure 4, CONV held low through the transfer). In the DSP use of Figure 3 CONV pulses low and returns high while D11..D0 are still clocked out; the model then floats DATA at CONV rise
conversion is clocked by CLK (D11 driven after the first CLK falling edge, D0 valid at the 13th rising edge, DATA Hi-Z after the 13th falling edge); not timed: the result is the 0 V code at once
LSB-first read-out (CONV pulled high before the 12th clock and low during the 13th) and short-cycling (CONV high then low during the conversion)
power-down when CONV is still low at the 13th clock, exited on CONV rising (no bus effect)
CONV-to-CLK setup/hold and clock period limits
variants: ADS7835 is the bipolar (+/-2.5 V, two's complement) version with a single AIN pin and two GND pins: own spec file.
